hook.name: YieldHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook that implements a custom constant-product AMM for a YIELD token, deploying asset reserves into ERC4626 vaults (MetaMorpho) to earn yield. Fully overrides swap execution via beforeSwap with delta returns (FLOOD-style), supporting YIELD/wstETH, YIELD/USDC, and YIELD/USDT pools. YIELD token holders can claim pro-rata vault yield via MasterChef-style accumulators.
